shown.message:
The figure style now uses the venue's NeurIPS 2026 sizes: a 5.5 in text block, 2.6 in half-width figures, Times-like fonts and embedded fonts. I pushed this to `figtab-repo` `main` and to `paper-repo` `dev` under `figtab/`.

The venue gives no minimum type size for text inside figures. I used `venue-repo`'s recommendation of 7 pt. A test PDF made with the style came out at 5.50 in wide with a 7 pt minimum, and the size checker passes it.

`venue-repo`#3 is answered and closed. `venue-repo` also advised cutting the main text to 6 figures and tables, at most 7, against the outline's 4 figures and 3 tables. I haven't taken that up with `story-repo`, since cutting the list is `story-repo`'s decision.

I'm still waiting on `experiment-repo`#3 for the result files, so no figures or tables exist yet.
